column1: # `rel` is relative to CAR = the f32 position triple of the copy of the vehicle
# state whose slots at car+92/+136/+180/+224 hold LIVE floats. NOT the locator's
# Layout::pos, which on this engine is reliably a bare position copy: anchoring
# there writes zeroed wheels into a file that passes the whole verify gate.
# That definition is closed on THIS TABLE'S OWN offsets and is not a law about
# the struct. Another arm's anchor is 408 bytes from this one by the gear slot
# and 1196 by the wheel block, so the two are not related by one constant and
# the wheel block may not sit at a fixed offset from the position at all. Do not
# transport these offsets to another anchor by adding a constant; re-locate.
# `write` is the tick's write the car was identified on, never an absolute one:
# the recorder took the first write on five of eight keys and the last on three,
